messages:
maddie: Quick sync — VegaHealth POC staging windows + PR ownership. Need final owners + timeline for integration deliverables. Goal: dry-run week of Mar 24. Success criteria: throughput baseline (90%), end-to-end <500ms p95, sample-eval pass >=95%. Who owns network, infra staging, SE acceptance, and PR reviews?

ryan: I can own network rules. We need a static egress IP and a firewall rule to allow their collector -> our staging endpoint. ETA to request IP from cloud team: 3/20.

sanju: I'll own SE acceptance + smoke tests. Can someone drop the canonical prompt set for VegaHealth (30 queries) and an expected output sketch? I'll run fuzz + golden checks.

kevin: Infra note: staging pool is available 3/22 09:00 PST but we need the image tagged with quantization=v1.2 and the model bundle path set. If you push the infra PR with the new image tag I can schedule the deploy.

amy: QA can run regression and load smoke on 3/23 10:00-14:00 PST. Need the test data and a stable stub for the external callback (we can't hit production webhooks).

maddie: Owners noted: network=@ryan, infra deploy=@kevin, SE acceptance=@sanju, QA=@amy. I'll coordinate callbacks. Ryan can you confirm static IP request ID when you have it?

ryan: filing request now — cloud ticket #CH-9821. ETA 3/20 EOD. Will @mention here when allocated. :thumbsup:

kevin: Infra PR opened for the cluster changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/poc-integration/pull/142
kevin: PR summary: set image tag redwood/infer:quant-v1.2, add k8s env VAR MODEL_PATH=/mnt/models/vega-v2, expose port 8080 for staging callbacks.

maddie: Thanks — can reviewers please ping when PR LGTM? We need it merged by 3/21 18:00 to hit staging on 3/22.

sanju: I'll review the PR today. Quick note: SE needs token rotation disabled for the staging service during tests (we'll rotate back after). Is that safe?

kevin: We can add a short-lived exception in the secret manager for staging only. I'll add a comment to the PR and a short runbook entry.

amy: For QA stubs — I uploaded a minimal callback stub to staging-test: https://internal.redwood.tools/stubs/vega-callback (auth token: staging-VEGA-TEST). Use it for the 3/23 run.

deploy-bot: Provisioning: staging cluster 'vega-stg' created on 2026-03-18T09:02:14Z (id: stg-312).

ryan: static IP allocated: 34.89.123.210 (CH-9821). I've added the cloud firewall rule to allow traffic from VegaHealth CIDR. Please use that IP in the Vega configuration.

maddie: Solid. Few outstanding items: (1) sample prompt set (sanju) (2) PR LGTM (sanju + one eng reviewer) (3) toggle for token rotation runbook (kevin) (4) QA runbook + dataset (amy). If we get those done by 3/21 EOD we hit dry-run week of 3/24.

sanju: Dropping sample prompts now (small set + edge cases). Link: https://drive.internal/redwood/vega/sample-prompts_v1.txt

kevin: Added runbook snippet in PR and will follow up with ops to disable rotation for staging between 3/22-3/24.

amy: Dataset uploaded and smoke scripts are in CI under tests/vega_smoke. I'll kick off a pre-run tomorrow and post the results.

maddie: Awesome — I'll assemble a short checklist and ping VegaHealth for a 30m dry-run slot on 3/24 11:00 PST. Thanks all. :tada:
